verdict.rationale: Galileo's documentation describes instrumented apps producing a real-time stream of sessions, traces, and spans, with metrics such as instruction_adherence enabled to monitor the model. It also documents alerts that fire when production logs show issues like rising hallucination rates. Marketing says evals can be distilled into Luna models that monitor 100% of traffic. Missing for 10: detailed docs on attaching evaluators to production log streams (sampling, configuration), and independent or hands-on confirmation that continuous online evaluation works as claimed.
